title: NOT THERMAL INSULATED
text: NOT THERMAL INSULATED. I ordered the olive and in my opinion, the color shown on my computer and what I received were pretty dang close.. they work perfectly, in color, for the room.  In all honestly these are NOT, I repeat, NOT "thermal insulated" curtains....  The packaging confirms this, and of course, once you get them out of the package, you can see they are just polyester curtains...The "up" side of this is that polyester washes up nicely. Now...if you're looking for strictly a "room darkening" curtain, these really do make the room darker.  I purchased them for our Arizona home so I was hoping for the thermal insulation, as noted in the ad.  The seller really needs to remove that part to be honest and fair.  I purchased 4 panels and one of the panels is a good 3/4" longer than the others.  Awkward.  And belies a quality control standard that is probably less than stellar... I do not see any holes noted in other reviews... I will probably be looking again to replace these with real thermal insulated curtains.  Hopefully I can find some that are as good a color match as these. In the meantime, we'll see how these do. I always update my reviews with relevant info if any issues pop up.
